generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of building evacuation drill (建筑疏散演练). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Show an orderly office evacuation drill spanning an indoor exit corridor and the visible outdoor assembly area beyond. A marshal wearing one high-visibility armband holds the roll-call clipboard beside the open emergency exit, without blocking it. Place the alarm call point on the near wall, smoke detector on the ceiling, illuminated exit light above the doorway and a folded evacuation chair beside the fire-stair door. Outside, one plain coloured assembly flag is visible. Architectural documentary photography, bright safety lighting, no smoke, flames, panic, crowds or readable safety words; use only universal colour and shape cues.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: fire alarm call point, smoke detector, emergency exit door, illuminated exit light, evacuation marshal, high-visibility armband, assembly-point flag, evacuation chair, fire-stair door, roll-call clipboard.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
